summary: Directly invoke a statically known compiled function only when ordinary JS call machinery is observationally irrelevant.

target.notes: Arguments are evaluated left-to-right before the call. This specialization excludes missing/extra argument and this semantics.

caveats: A JS callable may be a Proxy or bound function; dynamic callables need runtime dispatch.
Preserve evaluation order with temporaries when lowering complex callee/argument expressions.

tests.name: argument evaluation order
tests.input: let x=0; function f(a,b){return a*10+b;} console.log(f(++x,++x));
